zh: k 个连续正整数之和等于 k 乘以它们的中间值；按 k 的奇偶分开看，每一种写法都对应 num 的一个奇约数。
除了奇约数 1（只有 num 自己一项），每个奇约数恰好对应一种至少两项的写法，所以答案是 num 的奇约数个数减 1。
先把 num 里的因子 2 全部除掉；对剩下的奇数从 3 开始试除到平方根，每个质因子的指数为 e 就把 (e+1) 乘进结果；最后剩下的数若大于 1 再乘 2；输出乘积减 1。
en: A run of k consecutive positive integers adds up to k times its middle value; split by the parity of k, every way of writing num belongs to one odd divisor of num.
Apart from the odd divisor 1 (num on its own), each odd divisor gives exactly one way with at least two terms, so the answer is the number of odd divisors of num minus 1.

Divide every factor 2 out of num; trial-divide the odd part by 3, 5, 7, ... up to its square root, multiplying in (e + 1) for each prime with exponent e; multiply by 2 if a factor above 1 is left; print the product minus 1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Divide every factor 2 out of num, factor the odd part that remains, and subtract 1 from its number of positive divisors.

## Why it works

A run of odd length d is centred on num/d, where d is an odd divisor of num. If its first term is positive, that is one way of writing num. Otherwise the same odd divisor gives a run of even length 2num/d starting at (d+1)/2 - num/d, which is then positive: the two candidate first terms are integers adding up to 1, so exactly one of them is positive. Conversely, any run of consecutive positive integers gives back its d uniquely, from its length when that is odd and from the odd factor that goes with its length when it is even, so this is a bijection. The odd divisor 1 stands for num on its own, a single term, so it is subtracted.

## Complexity

Trial division takes O(sqrt(num)) time and O(1) extra space.
